name: Angel
description:
Ancient lore describes Angels as a fearsome host of glimmering celestials, with countless eyes and flaming wings. Then the link with the heavens broke, and the Angels vanished.

Most of them. One cherub of the lowest order stayed. Some stories say the host forgot them. Others say they fell, tempted by sweets.

What is left is a small winged thing, more fairy than host. They skitter, they swoop, and they steal sugar. The wings are a skill, not true flight, and the sugar runs out. Hunger burns twice as fast, and each finished meal restores half again as much.
